config.title: File Manager
config.language: Language of the File Manager. `auto` follows the language of VS Code; without a translation for it, English is used.
config.customTranslations: Your own translation: keys and texts as in `i18n/en.json` of the extension. When not empty, it is used instead of `#fileManager.language#`; keys it lacks are shown in English.
config.startFolder: Folder both panels open in a new File Manager tab. A tab restored after a window reload reopens its own folders.
config.startFolder.last: The folders last open in this workspace; the project folder the first time
config.startFolder.project: The first workspace folder; the home folder when there is none
config.startFolder.root: The root, or the drive list on Windows
config.tableScale: Pixels added to the editor font size in the tables. Ctrl+mouse wheel over the File Manager changes it.
config.hideExtensionOnRename: The rename dialog shows the name without its extension, which stays as it was.
config.unpackIntoSubfolder: Unpack into a subfolder named after the archive, unless changed in the dialog.
